A '''[[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]]''' served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Commander]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the decade marked by the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]]. When the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] erupted between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] they were selected to become the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] of a [[Ho'Din/Legends|Ho'Din]] [[Unidentified Ho'Din Jedi|Jedi]] [[Jedi healer/Legends|healer]] and took up the rank of [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Commander]] within the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. Together with their master, they traveled to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Nadiem/Legends|Nadiem]] after it was [[Battle of Nadiem|attacked]] by the Confederacy. They were aiding the evacuation effort with their master when they discovered the young [[Kennan Taanzer]] who impressed both Jedi with his calmness during all the madness of war surrounding him. After testing Taanzer's [[Blood/Legends|blood]], which revealed his [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-sensitivity, Taanzer was sent off-world where he would be eventually be relocated to the [[Bogden Jedi chapter house|Jedi chapter house]] on [[Bogden 3]].<ref name="P2" />
